latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of baoyu-infographic skill.
- Generates professional infographics with 21 layout types and 20 visual styles.
- Analyzes content, recommends optimal layout and style combinations, and produces publication-ready infographics.
- Includes galleries and definitions for all supported layouts and styles.
- Supports fully customizable options (layout, style, aspect ratio, language) and keyword shortcuts for common infographic scenarios.
- Workflow handles user, project, or default preferences, content analysis, and structured output organization.
